title: Exact values of Erdős's interval function up to eight primes: code, proof logs and Lean formalisation
description: Programs, proof logs and a Lean 4 formalisation accompanying the paper 'Exact values of Erdős's interval function up to eight primes' by D. Bhattacharjee, P. Mandal and U. Bhattacharya. The Lean project proves the upper bounds h(u) for u at most 8 (h(1), ..., h(8) = 1, 2, 2, 3, 2, 4, 3, 4) using only the standard axioms, with a verified checker for the proof logs of the certified search. The Python programs regenerate the proof logs, treat the sets with a small second prime, and verify the explicit good intervals behind the lower bounds.
